name: numbers-report
goal: Create and verify a small numbers report

argv: import json; from pathlib import Path; numbers=[int(x) for x in Path('numbers.csv').read_text().splitlines()]; Path('report.json').write_text(json.dumps({'count':len(numbers),'sum':sum(numbers)}))
import json; from pathlib import Path; report=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text()); assert report == {'count':3,'sum':10}; Path('verification.txt').write_text('PASS: 3 numbers total 10\n')
